reviews.comment: Professor Quiroz was hilarious and his lectures were really engaging. He has very clear grading criteria and his class is very easy, but i suggest going to each class because it was always interesting
Literally the best prof ever. Easy A and is so funny.

EXTREMELY EASY and INTERESTING course. Exams were extremely easy and open note. Goes over all exam questions and answers all questions. Exam is found on Canvas so you don't go to class on exam days. Two essays which are easy to follow as he gives a lot of direction. Makes sociology very interesting even for someone not majoring in sociology.

He's a really chill teacher. His tests are almost ridiculously easy & the lectures are easy to understand. Tests are open book so if you take notes it makes the tests even easier because the questions go chronological from latest to most recently learned material. The slides are a little bland but the content is interesting. Textbook not required.

Good option if you are looking for an easy A or just credit for SOCI 205. Exams were open-note, MC, and straightforward. We had two essays that were graded on a PASS/FAIL structure and he provided templates so those were easy to complete. Attendance Google Form every class. Ends class early sometimes. Nice guy and he clearly cares about sociology!

Super chill and understanding teacher. He understands that it is just an intro class and that we all have a lot of other classes to focus on so the tests and essays are very simple. I enjoyed going to class to hear his lectures and attendance was taken through a QR code. Highly recommend

His class was really good, he enjoys teaching and explains really well. Also, he understands that students have other heavy courses. Therefore, his exams and essays are easy. We had 2 papers and 3 exams this semester; for the essays he basically provided a templete for them, the exams are open note, and he also poste all of the slides.
